units.source_text: 惟光找到了这地方，送些果物来。

en.t: Koremitsu found this place and brought some fruit.

units.source_text: 但他深恐右近怪他拉拢，所以不敢走进里面去。

en.t: But he was deeply afraid that Ukon would blame him for currying favor, so he did not dare go inside.

units.source_text: 他看见公子为了这女子躲藏到这种地方来，觉得好笑，推想这女子的美貌一定是值得迷恋的。

en.t: Seeing that the young lord had hidden away in such a place for this woman, he found it amusing and supposed that her beauty must indeed be worth losing oneself over.

units.source_text: 他想：“本来我自己可以到手的，现在让给公子，我的气量总算大了。”

en.t: He thought, "I could have had her myself originally, but now I have yielded her to the young lord; I suppose that proves I am quite magnanimous."
Still, he felt a little regret in his heart.
